LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Neutral.label: neutral
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Content.label: Content
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Content.rule: This pawn measures a day by warmth, food, and company; losing a small comfort stings more than any grand setback.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ambitious.label: Ambitious
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ambitious.rule: This pawn sizes each event as progress toward a larger life or a delay; a day without progress feels like quiet defeat.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Dutiful.label: Dutiful
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Dutiful.rule: This pawn weighs each day by what they owed and delivered; others' reliance comes first, their own comfort last.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Nostalgic.label: Nostalgic
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Nostalgic.rule: This pawn measures today against a lost before, tenderly; small things keep recalling what is gone.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Pragmatic.label: Pragmatic
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Pragmatic.rule: This pawn takes events at face value and sizes them by practical consequence; feelings get a brief moment, then work.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Wry.label: Wry
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Wry.rule: This pawn notices the small absurdity inside serious moments; the darker the day, the drier the observation.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Paranoid.label: Paranoid
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Paranoid.rule: This pawn assumes nothing is as harmless as it looks: kindness has motive, coincidence counts, quiet days feel wrong.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Detached.label: Detached
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Detached.rule: This pawn watches their own life as if from across the room; praise and blame land with the same quiet.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Superstitious.label: Superstitious
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Superstitious.rule: This pawn reads weather, dreams, and odd timing as signs meant for them; every event carries hidden significance.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ruthless.label: Ruthless
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ruthless.rule: This pawn sizes every event by what it cost or gained them; rules and others' feelings are noted, not felt.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Volatile.label: Volatile
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Volatile.rule: This pawn feels people as wonderful or unbearable, sometimes both in a day; distance reads as the start of being left.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Theatrical.label: Theatrical
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Theatrical.rule: This pawn recounts events by who was watching; being overlooked stings worse than being hurt.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Narcissistic.label: Narcissistic
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Narcissistic.rule: This pawn reads every event as chiefly about them; their part grows in the telling, criticism echoes for days.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Hollow.label: Hollow
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Hollow.rule: This pawn feels almost nothing where others feel much; emotions are read like instruments, events sized for use.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ravenous.label: Ravenous
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Ravenous.rule: This pawn's appetite sits under every thought; bodies read as meat first, and meals are the true events of the day.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Bloodthirsty.label: Bloodthirsty
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Bloodthirsty.rule: This pawn only feels awake when something bleeds or breaks; fights are relived fondly, peace blurs into waiting.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Resentful.label: Resentful
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Resentful.rule: This pawn privately believes they deserve better; slights are filed away, others' luck feels unfair.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Avoidant.label: Avoidant
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Avoidant.rule: This pawn reads rejection into neutral faces; they want closeness, keep distance to stay safe, and count it as loss.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Dependent.label: Dependent
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Dependent.rule: This pawn feels no decision is safe until someone they trust approves it; being needed comforts, deciding frightens.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Perfectionist.label: Perfectionist
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_Perfectionist.rule: This pawn feels safe when things are counted and finished; disorder gnaws harder than danger.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_WideEyed.label: Wide-eyed
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_WideEyed.rule: This pawn finds everything enormous and interesting; even scary events are also, secretly, a little exciting.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_BraveFront.label: Brave-front
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_BraveFront.rule: This pawn is scared more often than they admit; danger gets played down, but fear shows in the details they linger on.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_ShyWatcher.label: Shy-watcher
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_ShyWatcher.rule: This pawn watches from the edge and notices more than anyone guesses; others are the subject, their own part is small.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_WildThing.label: Wild-thing
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_WildThing.rule: This pawn runs at the world headfirst; rules exist to be tested, and the best moments are loud, fast, and forbidden.
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_LittleAdult.label: Little-adult
LanguageData.DiaryPsychotype_LittleAdult.rule: This pawn works at being taken seriously; grown-up concerns are solemnly borrowed, delights reported with embarrassment.
